verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חָמֵשׁ֩ אַמּ֨וֹת אֹ֜רֶךְ וְחָמֵ֧שׁ אַמּ֣וֹת רֹ֗חַב רָב֤וּעַ יִהְיֶה֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְשָׁלֹ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת קֹמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ’eṯ- ham·miz·bê·aḥ ‘ă·ṣê šiṭ·ṭîm ḥā·mêš ’am·mō·wṯ ’ō·reḵ wə·ḥā·mêš ’am·mō·wṯ rō·ḥaḇ rā·ḇū·a‘ yih·yeh ham·miz·bê·aḥ wə·šā·lōš ’am·mō·wṯ qō·mā·ṯōw
verses.literal: You are to build an altar of acacia wood The altar must be square five cubits long five cubits wide and three cubits high
verses.literalPt: E de madeira de acácia farás também um altar que terá cinco cúbitos de comprimento e cinco cúbitos de largura (o altar será quadrado) e terá três cúbitos de altura.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ קַרְנֹתָ֗יו עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פִּנֹּתָ֔יו מִמֶּ֖נּוּ תִּהְיֶ֣יןָ קַרְנֹתָ֑יו וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹת֖וֹ נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā qar·nō·ṯāw ‘al ’ar·ba‘ pin·nō·ṯāw mim·men·nū tih·ye·nā qar·nō·ṯāw wə·ṣip·pî·ṯā ’ō·ṯōw nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: Make a horn on each of its four corners so that the horns are of one piece and overlay it with bronze
verses.literalPt: Dos quatro cantos farás levantar-se quatro chifres; os chifres formarão uma só peça com o altar; e o cobrirás de cobre.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ סִּֽירֹתָיו֙ לְדַשְּׁנ֔וֹ וְיָעָיו֙ וּמִזְרְקֹתָ֔יו וּמִזְלְגֹתָ֖יו וּמַחְתֹּתָ֑יו לְכָל־ כֵּלָ֖יו תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā sî·rō·ṯāw lə·ḏaš·šə·nōw wə·yā·‘āw ū·miz·rə·qō·ṯāw ū·miz·lə·ḡō·ṯāw ū·maḥ·tō·ṯāw lə·ḵāl kê·lāw ta·‘ă·śeh nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: Make . . . all its utensils of bronze its pots for removing ashes its shovels its sprinkling bowls its meat forks and its firepans
verses.literalPt: Far-lhe-ás cinzeiros, e pás, e bacias, e garfos, e braseiros; todos esses utensílios farás de cobre.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ לּוֹ֙ מִכְבָּ֔ר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֶ֣שֶׁת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ עַל־ הָרֶ֗שֶׁת אַרְבַּע֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת נְחֹ֔שֶׁת עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֥ע קְצוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā lōw miḵ·bār ma·‘ă·śêh re·šeṯ nə·ḥō·šeṯ wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ‘al- hā·re·šeṯ ’ar·ba‘ ṭab·bə·‘ōṯ nə·ḥō·šeṯ ‘al ’ar·ba‘ qə·ṣō·w·ṯāw
verses.literal: Construct for it a grate . . . of bronze mesh and make a bronze ring at each of the four corners of the mesh
verses.literalPt: Far-lhe-ás também uma grelha de cobre a modo de gelosia, à qual farás quatro argolas de cobre nos seus quatro cantos.

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֹתָ֗הּ תַּ֛חַת כַּרְכֹּ֥ב הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ מִלְּמָ֑טָּה וְהָיְתָ֣ה הָרֶ֔שֶׁת עַ֖ד חֲצִ֥י הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tāh ’ō·ṯāh ta·ḥaṯ kar·kōḇ ham·miz·bê·aḥ mil·lə·māṭ·ṭāh wə·hā·yə·ṯāh hā·re·šeṯ ‘aḏ ḥă·ṣî ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: Set the grate beneath the ledge of the altar so that the mesh comes halfway up the altar
verses.literalPt: Pô-la-ás de sob o rebordo da parte inferior do altar, de maneira que chegue até o meio do altar.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ בַדִּים֙ לַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ בַּדֵּ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ḇad·dîm lam·miz·bê·aḥ bad·dê ‘ă·ṣê šiṭ·ṭîm wə·ṣip·pî·ṯā ’ō·ṯām nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: Additionally, make poles of acacia wood for the altar and overlay them with bronze
verses.literalPt: Farás também varais para o altar, varais de madeira de acácia, e os cobrirás de cobre.

verses.original: וְהוּבָ֥א אֶת־ בַּדָּ֖יו בַּטַּבָּעֹ֑ת וְהָי֣וּ הַבַּדִּ֗ים עַל־ שְׁתֵּ֛י צַלְעֹ֥ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ בִּשְׂאֵ֥ת אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū·ḇā ’eṯ- bad·dāw baṭ·ṭab·bā·‘ōṯ wə·hā·yū hab·bad·dîm ‘al- šə·tê ṣal·‘ōṯ ham·miz·bê·aḥ biś·’êṯ ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: The poles are to be inserted into the rings so that the poles are on two sides of the altar when it is carried
verses.literalPt: Os varais se meterão nas argolas e estarão de um e outro lado do altar, quando for levado.

verses.original: נְב֥וּב לֻחֹ֖ת תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹת֑וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶרְאָ֥ה אֹתְךָ֛ בָּהָ֖ר כֵּ֥ן יַעֲשֽׂוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: nə·ḇūḇ lu·ḥōṯ ta·‘ă·śeh ’ō·ṯōw ka·’ă·šer her·’āh ’ō·ṯə·ḵā bā·hār kên ya·‘ă·śū
verses.literal: Construct the altar with boards so that it is hollow It is to be made just as you were shown on the mountain . . .
verses.literalPt: Oco e de tábuas o farás; como se te mostrou no monte, assim o farão.

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֕יתָ אֵ֖ת חֲצַ֣ר הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן לִפְאַ֣ת נֶֽגֶב־ תֵּ֠ימָנָה קְלָעִ֨ים לֶחָצֵ֜ר שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֗ר מֵאָ֤ה בָֽאַמָּה֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ לַפֵּאָ֖ה הָאֶחָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ’êṯ ḥă·ṣar ham·miš·kān lip̄·’aṯ ne·ḡeḇ- tê·mā·nāh qə·lā·‘îm le·ḥā·ṣêr šêš mā·šə·zār mê·’āh ḇā·’am·māh ’ō·reḵ lap·pê·’āh hā·’e·ḥāṯ
verses.literal: You are also to make a courtyard for the tabernacle On the south . . . side of the courtyard make curtains of finely spun linen a hundred cubits long on one side
verses.literalPt: Farás também o átrio do tabernáculo; para um lado, isto é, para o lado meridional, que olha para o sul, o átrio terá cortinas de linho fino retorcido de cem cúbitos de comprimento;

verses.original: וְעַמֻּדָ֣יו עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֥ם עֶשְׂרִ֖ים נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וָוֵ֧י הָעַמֻּדִ֛ים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘am·mu·ḏāw ‘eś·rîm wə·’aḏ·nê·hem ‘eś·rîm nə·ḥō·šeṯ wā·wê hā·‘am·mu·ḏîm wa·ḥă·šu·qê·hem kā·sep̄
verses.literal: with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases and silver hooks and bands on the posts
verses.literalPt: as suas colunas serão vinte, e as suas bases, vinte, todas feitas de cobre; os ganchos das colunas e as vergas serão de prata.

verses.original: וְכֵ֨ן לִפְאַ֤ת צָפוֹן֙ בָּאֹ֔רֶךְ קְלָעִ֖ים מֵ֣אָה אֹ֑רֶךְ וְעַמְדּוּ עֶשְׂרִ֗ים וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֤ם עֶשְׂרִים֙ נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וָוֵ֧י הָֽעַמֻּדִ֛ים וַחֲשֻׁקֵיהֶ֖ם כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵên lip̄·’aṯ ṣā·p̄ō·wn bā·’ō·reḵ qə·lā·‘îm mê·’āh ’ō·reḵ wə·ʿam·dū ‘eś·rîm wə·’aḏ·nê·hem ‘eś·rîm nə·ḥō·šeṯ wā·wê hā·‘am·mu·ḏîm wa·ḥă·šu·qê·hem kā·sep̄
verses.literal: Likewise there are to be curtains on the north side a hundred cubits long with twenty posts and twenty bronze bases and with silver hooks and bands on the posts
verses.literalPt: Igualmente para o lado do norte, ao comprido, haverá cortinas de cem cúbitos de comprimento, e serão vinte as suas colunas, e vinte, as suas bases, todas feitas de cobre; os ganchos das colunas e as vergas serão de prata.

verses.original: וְרֹ֤חַב הֶֽחָצֵר֙ לִפְאַת־ יָ֔ם קְלָעִ֖ים חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֑ה עַמֻּדֵיהֶ֣ם עֲשָׂרָ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם עֲשָׂרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rō·ḥaḇ he·ḥā·ṣêr lip̄·’aṯ- yām qə·lā·‘îm ḥă·miš·šîm ’am·māh ‘am·mu·ḏê·hem ‘ă·śā·rāh wə·’aḏ·nê·hem ‘ă·śā·rāh
verses.literal: The curtains on the west side of the courtyard shall be fifty cubits wide with ten posts and ten bases
verses.literalPt: Para a largura do átrio ao lado do ocidente haverá cortinas de cinquenta cúbitos; as colunas serão dez, e as suas bases, dez.

verses.original: וְרֹ֣חַב הֶֽחָצֵ֗ר לִפְאַ֛ת קֵ֥דְמָה מִזְרָ֖חָה חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אַמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rō·ḥaḇ he·ḥā·ṣêr lip̄·’aṯ qê·ḏə·māh miz·rā·ḥāh ḥă·miš·šîm ’am·māh
verses.literal: The east side of the courtyard toward the sunrise is to be fifty cubits wide
verses.literalPt: A largura do átrio ao lado oriental, que olha para o nascente, será de cinquenta cúbitos.

verses.original: וַחֲמֵ֨שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה אַמָּ֛ה קְלָעִ֖ים לַכָּתֵ֑ף עַמֻּדֵיהֶ֣ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wa·ḥă·mêš ‘eś·rêh ’am·māh qə·lā·‘îm lak·kā·ṯêp̄ ‘am·mu·ḏê·hem šə·lō·šāh wə·’aḏ·nê·hem šə·lō·šāh
verses.literal: Make the curtains on one side fifteen . . . cubits long with three posts and three bases
verses.literalPt: As cortinas para um lado da entrada serão de quinze cúbitos; as suas colunas serão três, e as suas bases, três.

verses.original: וְלַכָּתֵף֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔ית חְמֵ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה קְלָעִ֑ים עַמֻּדֵיהֶ֣ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lak·kā·ṯêp̄ haš·šê·nîṯ ḥə·mēš ‘eś·rêh qə·lā·‘îm ‘am·mu·ḏê·hem šə·lō·šāh wə·’aḏ·nê·hem šə·lō·šāh
verses.literal: and the curtains on the other side fifteen cubits long . . . with three posts and three bases
verses.literalPt: Para o outro lado da entrada haverá cortinas de quinze cúbitos; as suas colunas serão três, e as suas bases, três.

verses.original: וּלְשַׁ֨עַר הֶֽחָצֵ֜ר מָסָ֣ךְ׀ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּ֗ה תְּכֵ֨לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֜ן וְתוֹלַ֧עַת שָׁנִ֛י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָ֖ר מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֑ם עַמֻּֽדֵיהֶם֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם אַרְבָּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ša·‘ar he·ḥā·ṣêr mā·sāḵ ‘eś·rîm ’am·māh tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān wə·ṯō·w·la·‘aṯ šā·nî wə·šêš mā·šə·zār ma·‘ă·śêh rō·qêm ‘am·mu·ḏê·hem ’ar·bā·‘āh wə·’aḏ·nê·hem ’ar·bā·‘āh
verses.literal: The gate of the courtyard shall be twenty cubits long with a curtain embroidered with blue purple and scarlet yarn . . . and finely spun . . . linen It shall have four posts and four bases
verses.literalPt: Para a entrada do átrio haverá um anteparo de vinte cúbitos, de estofo azul, púrpura, escarlata e linho fino retorcido, obra de bordador; as suas colunas serão quatro, e as suas bases, quatro.

verses.original: כָּל־ עַמּוּדֵ֨י הֶֽחָצֵ֤ר סָבִיב֙ מְחֻשָּׁקִ֣ים כֶּ֔סֶף וָוֵיהֶ֖ם כָּ֑סֶף וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ‘am·mū·ḏê he·ḥā·ṣêr sā·ḇîḇ mə·ḥuš·šā·qîm ke·sep̄ wā·wê·hem kā·sep̄ wə·’aḏ·nê·hem nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: All the posts around the courtyard shall have silver bands . . . silver hooks and bronze bases
verses.literalPt: Todas as colunas ao redor do átrio terão vergas de prata; os seus ganchos serão de prata, e as suas bases, de cobre.

verses.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ הֶֽחָצֵר֩ מֵאָ֨ה בָֽאַמָּ֜ה וְרֹ֣חַב׀ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים בַּחֲמִשִּׁ֗ים וְקֹמָ֛ה חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֖ם נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·reḵ he·ḥā·ṣêr mê·’āh ḇā·’am·māh wə·rō·ḥaḇ ḥă·miš·šîm ba·ḥă·miš·šîm wə·qō·māh ḥā·mêš ’am·mō·wṯ šêš mā·šə·zār wə·’aḏ·nê·hem nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: The entire courtyard shall be a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide with curtains of finely spun linen five cubits high and with bronze bases
verses.literalPt: O átrio terá cem cúbitos de comprido e cinquenta de largo, por toda parte, e cinco de alto; as suas cortinas serão de linho fino retorcido, e as suas bases, de cobre.

verses.original: לְכֹל֙ כְּלֵ֣י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן בְּכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָת֑וֹ וְכָל־ יְתֵדֹתָ֛יו וְכָל־ יִתְדֹ֥ת הֶחָצֵ֖ר נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃ס
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵōl kə·lê ham·miš·kān bə·ḵōl ‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯōw wə·ḵāl yə·ṯê·ḏō·ṯāw wə·ḵāl yiṯ·ḏōṯ he·ḥā·ṣêr nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: All the utensils of the tabernacle for every use including all its tent pegs and the tent pegs of the courtyard shall be made of bronze
verses.literalPt: Todos os utensílios do tabernáculo em todo o seu serviço, e todos os seus pregos, e todos os pregos do átrio serão de cobre.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה תְּצַוֶּ֣ה׀ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְיִקְח֨וּ אֵלֶ֜יךָ שֶׁ֣מֶן זַ֥יִת זָ֛ךְ כָּתִ֖ית לַמָּא֑וֹר לְהַעֲלֹ֥ת נֵ֖ר תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh tə·ṣaw·weh ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·yiq·ḥū ’ê·le·ḵā še·men za·yiṯ zāḵ kā·ṯîṯ lam·mā·’ō·wr lə·ha·‘ă·lōṯ nêr tā·mîḏ
verses.literal: And you are to command the Israelites . . . to bring you pure oil of pressed olives for the light to keep the lamps burning continually
verses.literalPt: Ordenarás aos filhos de Israel que te tragam azeite puro de oliveira, espremido num gral, para o candeeiro, a fim de manter acesa uma lâmpada continuamente.

verses.original: בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֩ מִח֨וּץ לַפָּרֹ֜כֶת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הָעֵדֻ֗ת יַעֲרֹךְ֩ אֹת֨וֹ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו מֵעֶ֥רֶב עַד־ בֹּ֖קֶר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְדֹ֣רֹתָ֔ם מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ mi·ḥūṣ lap·pā·rō·ḵeṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ ya·‘ă·rōḵ ’ō·ṯōw ’a·hă·rōn ū·ḇā·nāw mê·‘e·reḇ ‘aḏ- bō·qer lip̄·nê Yah·weh ḥuq·qaṯ ‘ō·w·lām lə·ḏō·rō·ṯām mê·’êṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: In the Tent of Meeting outside the veil that is in front of the Testimony Aaron and his sons are to tend the lamps before the LORD from evening until morning This is to be a permanent statute for the Israelites . . . for the generations to come
verses.literalPt: Na tenda da revelação, fora do véu que está diante do Testemunho, Arão e seus filhos conservá-la-ão em ordem desde a tarde até pela manhã, perante Jeová; este será um estatuto perpétuo a favor dos filhos de Israel pelas suas gerações.
